picks.name: Christian Watson
picks.rationale: 82% for 25+ receiving yards. He has drawn 8 and 11 targets in the first two games (147 and 41 yards), and with Jayden Reed not practicing because of his neck, even more of Jordan Love's volume should funnel his way. Atlanta is also without top corner A.J. Terrell so far this week.

picks.name: Bijan Robinson
picks.rationale: Both models land at 86% for 40+ on the ground, and he has already cleared it twice this year (83 and 72 yards on 21 and 16 carries) with a backup QB under center. Atlanta is a 6-point road dog, which can shorten a back's night, but Bijan's carry share has held regardless of score.

picks.name: Jordan Love
picks.rationale: 73% for 175+ passing yards, with calm weather at Lambeau (upper 60s, light wind). The range is wide: 387 yards in Week 1, 145 in Week 2. Green Bay's line is banged up (starting LG Aaron Banks, RT Zach Bako-Bewele and backup guard Donovan Jennings all missed Monday's practice), so pressure is a real risk.

picks.name: Drake London
picks.rationale: 85% for 25+, and he got there both weeks (29, 51) despite Cooper Rush throwing him only 4-5 balls a game. Michael Penix Jr. is back and starting, which should help London's volume, but it is Penix's first game back from knee rehab, so we hold at B until we see how sharp the passing game is.

picks.name: Tucker Kraft
picks.rationale: Around 63% for 25+. With Reed likely out he could pick up extra short-area targets, but after just 3 targets in Week 2 we would rather watch than bet.

passes.name: Josh Jacobs
passes.reason: The board still simulates him off last season (66% for 40+ rushing), but he is on the Commissioner's Exempt List and has not played in 2026. Flagged no_games_yet; not a bet.

passes.name: Michael Penix Jr.
passes.reason: Passing 175+ at 67%, but our two models disagree sharply (49% vs 85%) and this is his first start since knee rehab. Too uncertain.

passes.name: Jayden Reed
passes.reason: Missed Monday's practice with a neck injury after a scary hit in Week 2. Not a bet unless he's cleared, and even then his workload is a question.
